% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
The identity \rawhtml*|<tp-math value="a^2 + b^2 = c^2" label="a squared plus b squared equals c squared"></tp-math>| describes a right triangle.
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/math/math.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("p");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("The identity "));

const element2 = document.createElement("tp-math");
element2.setAttribute("value", "a^2 + b^2 = c^2");
element2.setAttribute("label", "a squared plus b squared equals c squared");
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode(" describes a right triangle."));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Script and display style
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpMath{
  \wcScript[type=tp/math]|\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}|
}

\wcTpMath[displaystyle]{
  \wcScript[type=tp/math]|\frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}}|
}
\end{document}

% !tp-example AsciiMath
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
An inline expression: \wcTpMath*[mode=asciimath,value=1/(2sqrt(x)),label=One divided by twice the square root of x]{}.


\wcTpMath[mode=asciimath,value=1/(2sqrt(x)),displaystyle,label=One divided by twice the square root of x]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example External expression
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpMath[src=/docs/components/math/examples/identity.txt,displaystyle]{}
\end{document}
